# AppConsoleOutput

One piece of text an app run printed.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | `string` | The text, as printed (from `PrintLine` or `TraceLine`, it ends with a line break). |
| `type` | [`AppConsoleOutputType`](app-console-output-type.md) | Whether it is ordinary output (`Print`, `PrintLine`) or diagnostic output (`Trace`, `TraceLine`). |
| `date` | `datetime` | When it was printed, in UTC. |

## Example

```json
{
  "text": "...",
  "type": "Normal",
  "date": "2026-10-26T12:00:00.0000000Z"
}
```

## Where it's used

- Inside [`AppProcess`](app-process.md)
- Inside [`AppProcessWithDetails`](app-process-with-details.md)
